name: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Cook egg noodles according to package directions. Drain and set aside.
Season steak with salt and pepper. Sear in hot oil in batches until browned. Remove and set aside.
Melt butter in the same pan. Saute onion 5 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Sprinkle in flour and stir 2 minutes.
Pour in beef broth and Worcestershire sauce. Bring to a simmer, scraping up any browned bits.
Reduce heat to low. Stir in sour cream until smooth — do not boil.
Return beef to pan and heat through. Serve over egg noodles.

substitutions.dairy_free: Replace sour cream with full-fat coconut cream.
substitutions.gluten_free: Use gluten-free pasta and cornstarch instead of flour.
substitutions.low_carb: Serve over zucchini noodles instead of egg noodles.

notes: Never boil after adding sour cream or it will curdle.
